verdict.rationale: Gitea is documented as a free, self-hosted Git service. It installs as a single binary or official container image across many operating systems, and is configured through the admin panel for dynamic options and app.ini plus a restart for static ones. Hands-on reports confirm painless installs, smooth Docker setups and simple binary-swap upgrades. Missing for 10: first-party upgrade documentation, documented backup/restore and maintenance tooling (a community member questioned whether backup/restore is adequate), and a smoother upgrade path given reported 1.17 breaking changes.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can install, configure, upgrade, and maintain my own instance on my infrastructure

citations.quote: Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license. Full control, unlimited users and repositories.
or use container (docker/podman/etc) to deploy on your own server with the official image.
For dynamic config options, you can change it on your admin panel's configuration section. For static config options, you can edit your app.ini file and restart the instance.
This makes it convenient for individual developers or small teams to set up and manage their own Git services.
Each upgrade is super simple: stop the service, replace the single binary, start it.
